scope: Local branch candidate on stock CEF 154.0.34; no release or package
sourceBase: claude/admiring-chebyshev-9e5892 (74b6014, pinch-zoom screenshot coordinates) merged with PR #45 head 727e47b (rendered evidence in CSS pixels, which already merged main 2c222aa)
display: One 100% monitor; classic 15 CSS px scrollbars; 932x689 page view

chromiumSource.layoutMetrics: inspector_page_agent.cc getLayoutMetrics: cssLayoutViewport is the unpinched layout viewport; cssVisualViewport clientWidth/clientHeight are VisualViewport::VisibleRect (divided by pinch scale), and its pageX/pageY are the RootFrameViewport scroll offset (layout scroll plus pinch pan) in CSS pixels. visualViewport.clientWidth/cssVisualViewport.clientWidth is the layout-unit scale, independent of pinch.
chromiumSource.pageGeometry: local_dom_window.cc: innerWidth/innerHeight are the frame view size and scrollX/scrollY the layout viewport offset, unaffected by pinch; getBoundingClientRect and elementFromPoint use layout-viewport client coordinates. The in-page pointer check therefore cannot see a pinch.
chromiumSource.input: DOM.getBoxModel quads and Input.dispatchMouseEvent use visual-viewport CSS coordinates; dispatch has no bounds check, so a point past the visual viewport reaches content that is not on screen.

humanInput: The pinch came from the AuthTest-only driver (Chromium SyntheticTouchpadPinchGesture), not physical touch or touchpad input. Xenon does not classify a pinch as human activity, so the broker accepted a pre-pinch observation for the element-reference check.

findings.observe: Confirmed: while pinched 2x, a control at 764.9,16 outside the 458.5x344.5 view at 229,172 was reported verified with an action reference, the in-flow heading at the page top was reported, and the observation viewport was the 917x689 layout viewport.
findings.elementReference: Confirmed: a reference observed before the pinch was clicked after it. The page counted the click, and its listener saw 11 mousemove, mousedown, mouseup and click events outside the visual viewport.
findings.inspect: Confirmed: xenon_inspect returned inspection_changed on all 5 attempts while pinched (screenshot viewport visual, observation viewport layout).
findings.pointerMotion: Confirmed: moving from a position recorded before the pinch, 7 mousemove events reached the page outside the visual viewport before the click landed.
findings.scroll: Confirmed (found while testing): at 3x the wheel was dispatched at the layout viewport center, outside the visual viewport.

fix: visible_snapshot_viewport intersects the layout viewport with the visual viewport (layout units), so observe, query/wait, element revalidation and frame-chain checks treat only the magnified view as rendered. Observations report cssVisualViewport as their viewport, the same rectangle as screenshots; xenon_inspect compares them exactly. Element points must lie inside the visual viewport after frame translation. Pointer moves are clamped to the visual viewport, starting from the clamped last position. Scroll wheels go to the visual viewport center. Uncertain-click diagnostics compare the visual viewport.

beforeFix.note: Same merged source with the extended suite, before the native fix (Xenon.dll 005078756e603671da332d960810d658c21bb5a9ef55db88702666dbad2cd289 was built from it but not run live)
